speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You are here because you have not started your periods yet, have some unusual physical features, and your bones seem fragile. Can you describe exactly what physical features you have noticed that seem different from other girls your age?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (21-hydroxylase deficiency).
